description: A single transaction card in the transaction-list screen. Tap opens transaction/[id]; the inline category chip opens CategoryPicker to reassign. Geometry matches components/dashboard/RecentActivity.tsx for visual continuity.

date.description: ISO timestamp; time shown when grouped by day

onEditCategory.description: Opens CategoryPicker for this tx id

tokens.title: typography.smallBold + colors.text (numberOfLines 1)
tokens.categoryChipSet: fill ${colors.primary2}1f, border ${colors.primary2}3d, icon colors.accent, chevron colors.primary2, text colors.text
tokens.categoryChipUnset: dashed border colors.borderGlass, transparent fill, text colors.textMuted

accessibility.label: {title}, {type} {amount}, {category or 'no category'}, {date}, via {source}.
accessibility.categoryChipLabel: Category {name}, double tap to change / No category, double tap to set.
accessibility.touchTarget: row minHeight 64; category chip padded to 44 via hitSlop

notes: Amount is flexShrink:0 (never truncates); title ellipsizes. All rows are 'actual' (solid glass); the only ghosted element is an unset category chip.
